withdrawal_reason: COMPUTATIONAL_FEASIBILITY. 360 independent cell-worlds x 999 inner permutations is ~4-7 single-thread days. The paired design cuts Monte-Carlo noise between deltas and shares the expensive indexing, without changing the detection rule.

what_is_inherited_unchanged.base_noise: the real mfe_10d vector, permuted within the registered blocks — real scale, tails, date shocks and heteroskedasticity kept; sequence-outcome association destroyed
what_is_inherited_unchanged.injection: delta added ONLY to the frozen needle's membership, inside its overlap blocks
what_is_inherited_unchanged.detection: theta_needle > p95 of that world's max-null across all 840 claims
what_is_inherited_unchanged.reporting: measured finite-suite detection rate — never 'true power'
may_not: become a promotion route for any claim

pairing.outer: ONE outer base world per (needle, world_index): default_rng([20260820, needle_index, world_index]). The SAME base world is used for all six deltas of that needle/world.
pairing.inner: ONE set of 999 inner permutation mappings per (needle, world_index): default_rng([20260821, needle_index, world_index, perm_index]). The SAME mappings are applied at every delta.
pairing.band: theta_perm[999 x 840] and max_null[999] are RECOMPUTED separately for every delta, because the injected Y differs by delta and the permuted maxima may too. SHARED RANDOMNESS, SEPARATE BANDS — never one band reused across deltas.

y_status: may read mfe_10d for compute; historical ranking stays unexposed
